labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Rich already supports orange text through named colours, so this is a usage question rather than a bug or feature request.

items.body:
Rich already supports orange text. Use a named colour in markup, for example `[orange1]like this[/orange1]`, or pass `style="orange1"` to `Console.print`. Other named orange colours include `orange3`, `dark_orange` and `orange_red1`.

The full list of named colours is at
https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst
and the markup syntax is at
https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst

If this does not cover what you need, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), where usage questions are handled. Tell us the code you tried and what output you got.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
